gates.cmd: G=${GODOT:-$HOME/godot/Godot_v4.3-stable_linux.x86_64}; $G --headless --path . --import >/dev/null 2>&1; bad=0; for f in $(find scripts tests tools -name '*.gd' | sort); do out=$($G --headless --path . --check-only --script res://$f 2>&1 | grep -E 'ERROR|WARNING'); [ -n "$out" ] && echo "--- $f" && echo "$out" && bad=1; done; exit $bad

G=${GODOT:-$HOME/godot/Godot_v4.3-stable_linux.x86_64}; out=$($G --headless --path . --quit-after 1200 2>&1 | grep -vE 'mesh_get_surface_count|Parameter "m" is null|^\s*$|ObjectDB|cleanup \(core|^Godot Engine'); [ -z "$out" ] || { echo "$out"; exit 1; }
echo 'not a gate: tools/capture_screenshots.gd rewrites docs/screenshots. Run .claude/skills/ashen-wilds-milestone/scripts/capture.sh and look at every image.'
gates.note: rewrites tracked files, so it can't be a gate; checked by eye
